_comment: RiskEngine limits shared by backtest, paper and live (ADR-0015). Fractions of equity unless noted. Changing any value changes RiskConfig.version(), which every risk decision records. cooldown_minutes 0 = off (ADR-0054). ADR-0063: risk per trade scales with confidence from risk_per_trade (P<=risk_conf_low) to risk_per_trade_max (P>=risk_conf_high); looser daily-loss/drawdown limits.
